newsitem.title: LIBERIA: SOCCER-WEAH HEADER SEALS IT FOR LIBERIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WEAH HEADER SEALS IT FOR LIBERIA.

text.p: A stunning goal by George Weah helped Liberia beat the Democratic Republic of Congo 2-1 in an African Nations Cup group six qualifier on Sunday.
Liberia were already leading through a 20th minute goal from Kelvin Sebwe when AC Milan striker Weah sent a long pass to his cousin James Debbah on the right wing.
Debbah centred for Weah to head home after running from midfield.
Kraoda Nzanggni scored a consolation goal for Congo(formerly Zaire) in the 81st minute.
The match, watched by a capacity crowd of 45,000, completed a memorable weekend for Weah who had a statue of himself unveiled in Monrovia on Saturday.
